title: AAOS Event
description: One event record. A live log is many of these, one per NDJSON line — this schema describes ONE record.

protocol_version.description: Protocol version. Consumer: tools/validate.py (rejects a mismatched major version with a pointer to docs/MIGRATIONS.md).

event_id.description: Consumer: dedupe, escalation evidence_ref, event_log.md milestone cross-ref.

type.description: Consumer: expire-leases.py, project-notion.py, OPERATIONS.md state reconstruction.

actor.description: An agent id, or the literal "system" for the sweep. Consumer: audit, write_scope attribution.

refs.description: Consumer: project-notion.py + human audit (links event to objects).

task.description: Consumer: project-notion.py + human audit (links event to objects).

handoff.description: Consumer: project-notion.py + human audit (links event to objects).

lock.description: Consumer: project-notion.py + human audit (links event to objects).

escalation.description: Consumer: project-notion.py + human audit (links event to objects).

detail.description: Optional; pointer-first, no embedded data. Consumer: human audit (why LeaseContested, etc.).

event_log_ref.description: Optional; set only when a milestone event was mirrored to memory/event_log.md. Consumer: linkage-integrity check proving no duplication.
